DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS NETWORK CONTRACTING OFFICE 21 (NCO 21)

Description: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE FOR A REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ). 

VA Central California Health Care System has a future need for Hazardous Material Collection and training in Fresno, CA. 

Solicitation Number 36C26126Q0605 for this effort will be posted to SAM.GOV (https://sam.gov) on or about 04/17/2026.  This solicitation will contain all necessary specifications and information necessary to quote the project.
See solicitation for when questions must be submitted. 
Quotes are tentatively scheduled to be due on Friday, 05/01/2026 (see solicitation when available for specific time/date).

Point of Contact: Gary Christensen, Contract Specialist, gary.christensen@va.gov. 

Questions regarding this notice may be submitted via e-mail to gary.christensen@va.gov.
